title: CAR-based cellular therapy against breast cancer: a translational roadmap for engineering and clinical development.
snippet: CAR-T cell therapy has transformed clinical outcomes in selected hematologic malignancies, but its translation to breast cancer remains limited by antigen heterogeneity, on-target/off-tumor toxicity, poor tumor trafficking, and an immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment.
